name: satin-pro-styles
title: Satin Pro styles
description: Satin Pro's own classes and component CSS, precompiled: only what Satin styles doesn't already have. Import it after satin.css.

files.content:
/* @uisatin/pro: load after @uisatin/ui/styles.css. */
/*! tailwindcss v4.3.4 | MIT License | https://tailwindcss.com */@layer components;@layer utilities{.sa\:z-20{z-index:20}.sa\:mx-1{margin-inline:var(--sa-spacing)}.sa\:-ms-2{margin-inline-start:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * -2)}.sa\:mt-3{margin-top:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * 3)}.sa\:p-1\.5{padding:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * 1.5)}.sa\:line-through{text-decoration-line:line-through}.sa\:\[\&_svg\]\:text-text-destructive svg{color:var(--sa-text-destructive)}}.satin-agent-presence{z-index:10;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out), visibility 0s linear var(--sa-duration-fast);position:absolute;top:0;left:0}.satin-agent-presence[data-shown]{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out), visibility 0s}.satin-agent-presence[data-shown][data-glide]{transition:opacity var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out), visibility 0s, transform var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-in-out), width var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-in-out), height var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-in-out)}.satin-agent-presence-outline{border:1.5px solid var(--sa-tone-fg);border-radius:var(--sa-agent-presence-radius,var(--sa-radius-xl));transition:border-color var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out);position:absolute;inset:0}.satin-agent-presence-outline[data-state=conflict]{border-style:dashed}.satin-agent-presence-label{max-width:calc(100% - 16px);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--sa-tone-border);top:0;position:absolute;inset-inline-end:8px;overflow:hidden;transform:translateY(-50%)}.satin-agent-presence-label .satin-tetris{--sa-satin-tetris-on:var(--sa-tone-fg);--sa-satin-tetris-off:var(--sa-tone-border)}.satin-bulk-action-bar{transition:opacity var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-out), transform var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-out), visibility 0s}.satin-bulk-action-bar[data-state=closed]{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-out), transform var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-out), visibility 0s linear var(--sa-duration-slow);transform:translateY(8px)}.satin-bulk-roll{display:inline-grid;overflow:clip}.satin-bulk-roll>*{grid-area:1/1}.satin-bulk-roll[data-dir=up]>[data-roll=out]{animation:satin-bulk-roll-out-up var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out) forwards}.satin-bulk-roll[data-dir=up]>[data-roll=in]{animation:satin-bulk-roll-in-up var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out)}.satin-bulk-roll[data-dir=down]>[data-roll=out]{animation:satin-bulk-roll-out-down var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out) forwards}.satin-bulk-roll[data-dir=down]>[data-roll=in]{animation:satin-bulk-roll-in-down var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out)}@keyframes satin-bulk-roll-in-up{0%{transform:translateY(100%)}}@keyframes satin-bulk-roll-out-up{to{transform:translateY(-100%)}}@keyframes satin-bulk-roll-in-down{0%{transform:translateY(-100%)}}@keyframes satin-bulk-roll-out-down{to{transform:translateY(100%)}}
